title: Yes it is loud, but...
text: Yes it is loud, but.... Super loud but extremely annoying to set the time and alarms. We need to change to alarm time to adjust for different scheduled days. Not user friendly at all and definitely should and could improve this if they wanted to. Many people have complained but obviously the company still makes sales on waking the dead, so why fix it.
